name: R.M. Flagg Restaurant Supply
old_description: R.M. Flagg has been in business since 1928. Our customer service and expertise have stood the test of time.
about:
R.M. Flagg Restaurant Supply has operated from Veazie, Maine since 1928. The family-owned business began as a local source for restaurant equipment and kitchen supplies and has remained under family stewardship for nearly a century.

The company functions as a full-line dealer for major food-service equipment brands, stocking more than 10,000 items across two on-site warehouses and a showroom. Its product range spans commercial refrigeration, cooking equipment, small wares, bar supplies, countertop appliances, furniture, and disposables. Beyond sales, Flagg provides complete kitchen design packages using AutoCAD drawings and schematics, and its own installation crew handles delivery and setup of commercial equipment throughout Maine.

Customers include independent restaurants, convenience-store chains, summer camps, food trucks, hospitals, schools, and the general public. The firm serves both small single-item orders and large multi-site rollouts, with project experience ranging from custom refrigeration to full dining-room fit-outs.

Flagg emphasizes its local, family-owned structure as a differentiator, citing the ability to offer personalized service, deep product knowledge, and hassle-free project management from design through installation.
